What’s new in Clipora.

Current public Store package checked 29 October 2026: version 2.0.5.0 for Windows x64. Availability and update timing can vary by market and device.

On this page
2.0.5.0 — Update visibilityEarlier 2.0 improvements included in the current package29 October 2026 — Website discovery and toolsHow to get an update

2.0.5.0 — Update visibility

Open Updates in the workspace or Settings → General → Updates to view the installed version and check for published updates. Automatic checks can be disabled in General settings.

Store installations open a user-initiated Microsoft Store update flow. Standalone installations check the public release feed and link to the Store. Their libraries remain separate; use encrypted export and restore to transfer one.

Package identity verified in Microsoft’s public US/en-US catalog. This does not mean every device has installed that version.

Earlier 2.0 improvements included in the current package

  • Quick-access image previews, compact appearance controls and persistent pin feedback.
  • Selection, ordering and drag behavior corrections.
  • Custom-domain help and privacy links.
  • Windows startup registration improvements for the standalone edition.

Store startup is also governed by Windows startup settings. If the app does not start at sign-in, follow the startup troubleshooting steps.

29 October 2026 — Website discovery and tools

The website now puts a guided clipboard demo beside the introduction, adds practical Windows guides and sourced comparisons, and includes browser-local plain-text and line-break tools.

These are website changes. They do not change the native app’s version or add new clipboard capture permissions.

How to get an update

  1. Open the Microsoft Store app and check its Library / Downloads area for updates.
  2. Keep automatic Store updates enabled if that fits your preference.
  3. After updating, open Clipora’s Updates page to confirm the installed version.

Store updates retain application storage. Resetting or uninstalling can remove it. Export a verified encrypted backup before a reset, uninstall or migration.
